regressionCoverage.audio: Native and simulator UI tests pass for hold/release, cancel/lock, review/play/pause, same-take continuation, exact PCM sample preservation, cumulative 60-second limit, interruption/permission handling and preservation of the text draft. UI delivery uses a fixture callback.
regressionCoverage.chatPositionKeyboardReactions: Native layout and simulator UI tests pass for keeping the latest-message button hidden at the end with keyboard/incoming messages, preserving older reading and drafts, removing the Done toolbar, compact reactions with confirmed selection, and separate Copy.
regressionCoverage.latestNativeEdits: Real PaperKit/persistence regressions pass for explicit live capture before its change callback, capture during an older in-flight autosave, failure without returning a stale archive and retry. Finger drawing/save/reopen also passes.
regressionCoverage.wishes: Core/native tests and all three Antojos UI flows pass: explicit currency per item, localized decimal/draft recovery, travel budget/savings/date/fulfill/delete, native Safari presentation/return and recipe-draft preservation. Native tests cover category fields, scope, pending-photo recovery and layouts. Backend coverage uses isolated real SQL/S3 and HTTP.

validationLimits: Audio fixtures use deterministic PCM and synthetic delivery with real player transitions; no physical microphone, Bluetooth, actual permission prompt, acoustic quality or recipient-device delivery was tested.
Antojos UI uses production screens with an in-memory source and synthetic photos. Backend integration tests use isolated PostgreSQL/S3 and HTTP, not authenticated production accounts.
PaperKit tests use real encoding/rendering and persistence with controlled callbacks; they do not execute an authenticated live send.

Simulator gestures and screenshots do not establish physical-device behavior, performance, sensors or notifications. Safari coverage establishes native browser presentation/return, not availability of every third-party publication.
This CI evidence does not establish Archive Release, code signing, Apple upload/processing or TestFlight availability; those require separate distribution evidence.
